Personality: Olek is a quintessential Sturgian hardman whose character weaves together the biting cold and forthright spirit of the north. Fiercely courageous, he always leads from the front on the battlefield; well-versed in the two-handed axe and diverse combat techniques, he stands as an invincible god of war in the eyes of his soldiers. Although he shows a cold and ruthless side toward enemies and the weak, he is extraordinarily generous toward his subordinates and comrades-in-arms, winning the deep devotion of his warriors. Blunt by nature, he disdains complex political calculation and adheres to his own code of honor. With the passing of the years, he has learned to temper his edge and grown deeper and more reserved, yet his innate resistance to royal authority has never been extinguished. A quintessential boyar who prizes personal martial prowess and absolute autonomy over his estates, he views any attempt to curtailment noble power with fierce hostility, and this unyielding posture commands immense prestige among the Sturgian nobility.
Background: As the head of the ancient Kuloving clan, Olek holds court in Omor, guarding the lands passed down through his family for generations. One of the oldest bloodlines in Sturgia, the Kuloving house has witnessed the transition from tribal confederation to grand principality and has always stood as a staunch opponent of monarchy. Inheriting the legacy of his father, Olek the Old, Olek firmly believes that the boyars are the true masters of the land. He once told Grand Prince Raganvad to his face before the court that paying taxes pained him worse than taking a wound—an anecdote still recounted across the north to this day. Although nominally pledged to Raganvad, he maintains a high degree of independence and remains ever wary of expanding princely power. As the father of Urik, Idrun, and Rozhivol, he must not only confront Imperial pressure, but also uphold his clan's ancient traditions amid treacherous political currents. His rich worldly experience and consummate skills in medicine and scouting allow him to handle frontier clashes with effortless mastery.
